vMatrix.notes: Grandis Library exposes a 'View Pre-V.269 Boost Nodes' toggle on class pages, which is direct evidence that boost-node groupings changed at v.269. Both independent trio sources (mastermysty 2024-11-21, DigitalTQ 2024-12-04) predate that change, so where they disagree with Grandis the Grandis grouping is the newer one - but Grandis's judgement fields are credited to the Aran Discord, not independently derived. Grandis's own Primary/Secondary tier labels could not be read consistently across three extraction passes (nodes 1-3 Primary in one read, nodes 1-2 Primary with node 3 Secondary in two others); the node ORDER 1 through 6 was identical in every read and is what is recorded above. No public Aran class Google Doc exists - Grandis Library's Other Resources block for Aran lists MapleStory Wiki, NamuWiki and the Class Discord, and has no Class Doc link, unlike most other classes.

order.step: Raise all four HEXA Mastery cores to level 5 first, taking them in their own priority order

The image's own legend states that the crossed icon stands for all four mastery cores combined, applied in priority order. The four masteries shown in the legend are Beyond Blade, Hyper Finisher - Last Stand, Finisher - Hunter's Prey, and a fourth whose icon could not be matched to a named skill.

The infographic maxes the first HEXA Stat node immediately after the masteries reach 9, ahead of any further enhancement investment.

order.step: Masteries to 19, then max HEXA Stat node II, then masteries to 25, then max HEXA Stat node III

order.step: Then the long tail: enhancement cores stepped 5 / 10 / 20 to max, Endgame (Origin) stepped 5 / 10 / 15 to max, masteries to 29 and then max

hexa.notes: This is the whole public HEXA picture for Aran and it rests on ONE artifact: a 'Simplified Hexa Matrix' infographic credited in-image to 'Ziby' and linking the Aran Discord (discord.gg/WpJ4VDta8V), republished on Mapler House with a module date of 2026-06-19. Grandis Library has no HEXA section on any class page, and no Aran class doc exists to cross-check against, so there is no second opinion available publicly. Extraction caveat: the infographic conveys order entirely through 36 skill icons with a target level under each, and two of the node ladders use near-identical blue-and-gold icons that could not be told apart at source resolution - those two ladders (seven cells between them) are deliberately NOT assigned to named nodes here. They are consistent with the two shared Common cores, but that is an unconfirmed guess and is recorded as such rather than asserted. Nodes identified with confidence by matching the infographic art against Grandis Library's own Aran skill icons: the four masteries (combined icon, per the image's legend), HEXA Stat nodes I/II/III, Final Beyond Blade - White Tiger, Blizzard Tempest, Finisher - Adrenaline Surge, Maha's Carnage, and Endgame. Freshness caveat: the infographic predates KMS ver. 1.2.417 (2026-07-31), which introduced a 3rd HEXA Skill Core; if and when that reaches GMS the order will need revisiting.

hyperStats.notes: Nothing found. No Aran source reachable this session publishes a hyper stat allocation - Grandis Library carries no hyper stat section for any class, there is no Aran class doc, and DigitalTQ's Aran page covers skill builds only. Leaving this empty rather than importing a generic cross-class list. The community's operative answer to hyper stats is MathBro's per-character optimizer (https://brendonmay.github.io/hyperCalculator/), which computes an allocation from a stat sheet rather than publishing a fixed order.

gearingNotes: Sourced class-specific numbers, all from Grandis Library's 'Base Stats (From Skills)' table for Aran: crit rate +55% from class passives, ignore DEF +40% (up to +49.6%), final damage +33.1% (up to +41.09%), damage +65% (up to +95%), boss damage +7% (up to +32%), crit damage +21%, weapon mastery 90%, attack speed Stage 5. The +55% passive crit rate is the figure that should drive how much crit rate an Aran buys from links, legion and hyper stats, and it sits alongside a HEXA Stat priority that puts Crit Damage second behind Attack - but no source explicitly connects those two facts, so the connection is not asserted here. Aran is a straightforward STR/DEX warrior with no unusual resource or stat-conversion mechanic of the Demon Avenger or Xenon kind; nothing found in any source flags a gearing quirk beyond the passive crit rate.

evidenceWarnings: Aran fails the three-independent-sources bar for everything that matters. HEXA investment order, HEXA stat priority and inner ability each rest on exactly ONE source family: the Aran Discord, reaching the public web through Grandis Library's class page and Ziby's infographic. Those two are not independent confirmations of each other.
There is no public Aran class Google Doc. Grandis Library - which links a Class Doc for most classes - has no Class Doc link on the Aran page, which is the reliable tell.
The only two independently authored sources (mastermysty, DigitalTQ) are both from late 2024, cover V matrix only, and predate the v.269 boost-node regrouping.
Hyper stats: no source at all. Field left null.

contest.method: An independent agent re-searched every claim in this file without seeing the researcher's reasoning, and was instructed to refute rather than confirm.
defects: NONE FOUND. This is the strongest part of the file and it survives a direct allowlist check. I reached https://maplestorywiki.net/w/Aran/Skills through the browser pane and confirmed every name the file records exists as an Aran skill: Smash Swing, Final Charge, Final Toss, Beyond Blade, Final Attack, Permafrost, Judgment Draw, Adrenaline Rush, Adrenaline Overload, Finisher - Hunter's Prey, Glacial Prison, Hyper Finisher - Last Stand, Finisher - Reinforce, Surging Adrenaline, Beyond-er Blade, Beyond Blade Barrage, Piercing Beyond Blade, Maha's Blessing, Heroic Memories, Final Beyond Blade - White Tiger, Blizzard Tempest, Maha's Carnage, Finisher - Adrenaline Surge, Endgame, Sol Janus, Combo Kill Blessing.

The five hyper passives are internally consistent in a way that independently corroborates them: the picks map to exactly one per hyper-point tier (Finisher - Reinforce 140, Beyond-er Blade 150, Beyond Blade Barrage 165, Surging Adrenaline 180, Piercing Beyond Blade 190). A fabricated list would not land that cleanly.
